value.rationale: This naturally parameterized kernel approximation problem requires both a cyclic sampling geometry and an analytic RKHS norm. It now has an exact capture law for every degree and every positive power kernel, a unique optimizing radius, an algebraic classical Bergman specialization, and a universal large-degree constant with explicit residue correction. This quantitatively measures the performance of an entire structured kernel-dictionary class; it is not merely re-evaluating a known table or a single arbitrary degree.
